Every carbon:13in the source procaine salt and6in vitaminC. Hybridization recognition preserves the complete source task; no N/O hybridization or stereochemical assignment is requested.

All 12 nonterminal atoms, including all eight carbons, ring nitrogen, phenolic oxygen, bridging oxygen and phosphorus; two assignments per atom. Use the textbook Chapter 1 localized hybrid-orbital model and approximate ideal angles: sp² corresponds to 120°, and sp³ to 109.5° (often rounded to 109°). These are geometry estimates, not experimentally determined angles for this molecule. The phenolic oxygen is called sp³ in this introductory convention; later resonance-aware descriptions can emphasize its conjugated p lone pair. No exact measured angle or unique orbital decomposition is implied. Phosphate P uses the chapter’s approximate tetrahedral sp³ label; this does not assert literal d-orbital participation in its P–O bonding.
